# Command placement: every command has its button

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask commands-ui` from the `place`, `shortcut` and `enabled` fields of crates/engine/src/commands.rs; `cargo xtask docs` fails when it is stale. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every engine command declares where its button lives in the app (AGENTS.md §9, ROADMAP M11.1): a group of a ribbon tab, a context menu, or the command palette only (Ctrl+Shift+P), with a short UI label and an icon; an optional shortcut; and what the session needs before the button is enabled. The palette lists every command the session's role and server policy allow, whatever its place. `list_commands` and `bicraft-cli describe` show the same fields (`place`, `shortcut`, `needs`, `form`; with a session also `enabled` and `disabled_reason`), see [mcp.md](mcp.md). The types are in `crates/engine/src/command_ui.rs`; the tabs follow docs/design.md §5 and Power BI Desktop's ribbon (File backstage, Home, Insert, then Report, Model, Data, Analyze, View and Optimize, plus the contextual Visual, Table and Measure tabs that appear with a selection).

Needs: `file` an open file; `saved_report_file` a PBIX, PBIT or PBIP file; `project` a PBIP project; `model` a model (open or new); `report` a report; `no_report` no report yet; `data` stored data (a PBIX DataModel or a PBIP cache.abf); `undo` / `redo` a step to undo or redo. Read-only callers (`reader` grants) see only the commands that read, and a server refuses what its policy denies; both come on top of the needs.

## Shortcuts

Office and DeckCraft conventions (Ctrl on Windows, Linux and in the browser). Each chord belongs to one command; the UI keeps Ctrl+Shift+P for the palette.

| Shortcut | Command | Label |
|---|---|---|
| Ctrl+O | `file.open` | Open |
| Ctrl+S | `file.save` | Save |
| Ctrl+Shift+S | `file.save_as` | Save as |
| Ctrl+N | `model.new` | New model |
| Ctrl+M | `page.add` | New page |
| Delete | `visual.remove` | Delete visual |
| Ctrl+C | `visual.copy` | Copy |
| Ctrl+X | `visual.cut` | Cut |
| Ctrl+V | `visual.paste` | Paste |
| Ctrl+D | `visual.duplicate` | Duplicate |
| F5 | `model.refresh` | Refresh |
| Ctrl+Z | `edit.undo` | Undo |
| Ctrl+Y | `edit.redo` | Redo |
